name: ATASHINORIRI
source:
Welcome to Neko Academy, where Neko-chans and humans get along and learn magic together! Play as Kento-kun and find true love in this heart-pounding adventure game!

[Edited from [URL=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=16451]Lemma Soft Forums[/URL]]
translation:
欢迎来到猫学院，猫娘和人类在这里和睦相处、一起学习魔法！扮演健人君，在这款令人心跳加速的冒险游戏中找到真爱吧！

[编辑自[URL=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=16451]Lemma Soft Forums[/URL]]
